lines: Tilo is open. Anyone can join now, for free. No invite, and no waiting list.
Tilo is a studio and a gallery for drawing by hand. Every piece keeps its recording, stroke by stroke.
To join, go to tiloart dot com slash join, and type your email.
Tilo emails you a link. There's no password. Press it, and you're signed in.
Pick your handle, tick the box, and you're a member.
Open the studio. Choose a pencil, ink, or pixels, and draw.
Publish it, and it hangs in the gallery, where anyone can replay how you drew it.
Stamp the pieces you love, follow artists, and add your marks to the shared wall.
Tilo is free, and it stays free. Join today, at tiloart dot com slash join.
